newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIUM HAS PRAISE, CRITICIM FOR DEAD DENG.
newsitem.headline: BELGIUM HAS PRAISE, CRITICIM FOR DEAD DENG.

text.p: Belgian Prime Minister Jean-Luc Dehaene said on Thursday that news of the death of Deng Xiaoping had saddened him and praised the Chinese leader for his historical role in the development of modern China.
In a statement the Belgian leader underscored Deng's "important impulses" for the Chinese economy without compromising the country's stability.
Foreign Minister Erik Derycke told Belgian radio Deng would be remembered for "opening up" China and turning the vast country into an economic world power.
Speaking from India, which he is visiting as part of a tour of Asia, Derycke noted Deng had, however, done little to improve China's poor human rights record. "He never wanted democratisation."
He expected a group leadership to take control of the country while the Communist Party worked the issue of his succession.
